evidence_quote: The aim of this study was to gain a comprehensive understanding of health-related quality of life (HRQoL) in patients undergoing MIRPE.
rationale: The study examines quality of life after surgical repair of a chest wall deformity. It does not investigate brain or neural mechanisms, cognition, neurological disease, neural injury, or neurological treatments or biomarkers. Reported pain and fatigue do not establish a neuroscience focus.
